name: sms-twilio
description: External SMS provider: implements sms@1 (read-only) on the Twilio REST API 2010-04-01 - multiple numbers (one credential pair per label, different Twilio accounts allowed), a configurable default number, inbound listing and single-message read

config.description: No `numbers` is a valid state: the plugin then loads and reports 'not configured' without registering the provider. Every request is READ-ONLY (GET on the Messages resource); sending SMS is not implemented.

defaultNumber.description: Label of the number a call without an explicit reference resolves to. When absent the first configured label is the default.

numbers.description: One entry per LABEL: { number (the TO number whose inbox is read), accountSid (literal AC... or ${cred:NAME}), authToken (literal or ${cred:NAME}, never logged), apiBase?, description? }. A reference is resolved at CALL time through ctx.credentials, so a credential that is missing or empty leaves the plugin LOADED with that label reported configured:false; only a call for it fails.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout of one request in milliseconds (default 8000, max 60000).

maxPages.description: How many result pages one list() call may walk (default 3, max 10).

pageSize.description: PageSize asked of Twilio, capped at 100 (Twilio's own maximum).

maxBodyChars.description: Cap of a returned message body in characters (default 2000, the contract's cap).
